summary: Site Diary V2 backend + frontend flagship rebuild tested end-to-end. Backend: 13/13 pytest tests passed (reference lists, entries create/list/patch/delete + soft-delete/404/400 edge cases, stats shape+values, templates CRUD). Frontend: dashboard route /app/site-diary renders 5 stat cards + New Diary Entry, wizard opens with 11-step stepper, all 11 step wrappers found (after fix), Step 3 auto-computes totalOperatives from crew count (2 crew added → total 2), Step 7 has all 5 subsection add-buttons (delays/issues/instructions/hs/visitors), Step 9 renders AttachMedia for Photo Vault, Step 11 exposes preview + save-btn + notes + preparedBy + sign, filters (search/project/from/to) present, backwards-compat redirect /app/tool/site-diary → /app/site-diary confirmed.

issues: Pre-existing hydration warning (span inserted inside <option> by preview instrumentation) — same class of warning noted in iterations 16/17, not blocking.

collect_site_diary_attention is properly gated (>=17:00 UTC) and avoids duplicates by checking today's diary entries.
Fixed: Step 9 wrapper was missing data-testid="sd-step-9-photos" — added directly by testing agent to align with the requested test-id contract.
Total operatives is auto-computed and marked readOnly which correctly implements the spec.

seed_data_creation: Backend test suite creates TEST_SD_Project entry + TEST_SD_Tpl template and soft-deletes both during the same run. No residual test rows.
